mission: Design the 2-worker and 5-worker identical-bootstrap race canary, including expected claim collisions, losing-worker retry behavior, evidence, pass/fail conditions, vanished-worker cases and non-duplication assertions. Do not execute production mutation tests.
selection_reason: Higher-priority universal-swarm lanes were consumed by live races. This still-unclaimed isolated verification design directly exercises the collision/retry behavior currently observed in the broad /wc wave and can produce reusable falsification criteria without shared mutation.
